verses.gurmukhi: ਮਾਣਸ ਜਨਮੁ ਅਮੋਲੁ ਹੈ ਹੋਇ ਅਮੋਲੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ ਪਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: maanas janam amol hai hoi amol saadhasa(n)g paae|

en.bdb: Human life is invaluable and by being born man gets the company of the holy congregation.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਖੀ ਦੁਇ ਨਿਰਮੋਲਕਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦਰਸ ਧਿਆਨ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: akhee dhui niramolakaa satigur dharas dhiaan liv laae|

en.bdb: Both the eyes are invaluable who behold the true Guru and concentrating upon the Guru remain immersed in Him.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਸਤਕੁ ਸੀਸੁ ਅਮੋਲੁ ਹੈ ਚਰਣ ਸਰਣਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਧੂੜਿ ਸੁਹਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: masatak sees amol hai charan saran gur dhooR suhaae|

en.bdb: The forehead is also invaluable which remaining in the shelter of the feet of the Guru adorns itself with the dust of the Guru.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਹਬਾ ਸ੍ਰਵਣ ਅਮੋਲਕਾ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਸਮਝਿ ਸੁਣਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: jihabaa sravan amolakaa sabadh surat sun samajh sunaae|

en.bdb: Tongue and ears are also invaluable which carefully understanding and listening to the Word make other people also understand and listen.

verses.gurmukhi: ਹਸਤ ਚਰਣ ਨਿਰਮੋਲਕਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਸੇਵ ਕਮਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: hasat charan niramolakaa gurmukh maarag sev kamaae|

en.bdb: Hands and feet are also invaluable which move on the way of becoming gurmukh and perform service.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਿਦਾ ਅਮੋਲੁ ਹੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਵਸਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh ridhaa amol hai a(n)dhar gur upadhes vasaae|

en.bdb: Invaluable is the heart of gurmukh wherein resides the teaching of the Guru.
Whosoever becomes equal to such gurmukhs, is respected in the court of the Lord.
